long_term_logic: SF Holding is a large integrated logistics company covering time-definite express, economy express, freight, intra-city, supply-chain and international services.
2025 revenue was about 308.23 billion yuan, attributable net profit about 11.12 billion yuan, and operating cash flow about 27.56 billion yuan.
Management's 2025 review emphasized digital/intelligent operations and international/cross-border logistics expansion.
swing_logic: No confirmed positive swing trend: 2026-06-02 close is below 20/60/120/240-day moving averages.
Relative performance versus CSI 300 is weak across 20/60/120/240-day windows.
core_assumptions: Logistics demand remains resilient enough for stable revenue growth.
Operating efficiency, business mix and international/supply-chain growth can support margins.
Low valuation creates odds only if earnings are not revised down.
most_likely_failure_points: Logistics price competition or macro demand weakness compresses margins.
International business is affected by trade frictions, energy prices, FX and geopolitical risk.
Low valuation remains low because market does not price the business as a growth asset.

business_logic.evidence: Integrated logistics leader with real demand, scale, brand and strong operating cash flow.

industry_theme_fit.evidence: Logistics is not an A/B tactical theme in the current theme registry; cannot be treated as offensive core.

financial_quality.evidence: 2025 ROE about 11.62%, debt-to-assets about 49.03%; 2026Q1 debt-to-assets about 47.80%; cash flow is solid.

earnings_trend.evidence: 2025 revenue +8.37% and attributable net profit +9.30%; 2026Q1 revenue +6.14% and attributable net profit +13.05%.

valuation_odds.evidence: PE(TTM), PB and PS(TTM) are around the lowest percentile in the 582-observation sample since 2024.

trend_fund_flow.evidence: Price is below 20/60/120/240-day averages; 5-day and 20-day Tushare moneyflow sums are negative; relative performance is weak versus CSI 300.

risk_controllability.evidence: Risks are identifiable, but macro demand, price competition, international exposure and asset-heavy structure require monitoring.

stock_risk_penalty.evidence: Penalty for weak trend, negative moneyflow, non-theme status, international and industry competition risks.
stock_risk_penalty.operation_limit: Watch only; no buy/add/reduce/sell action is generated in this dossier.

financials_and_earnings.financial_quality: 2025 revenue about 308.23 billion yuan, attributable net profit about 11.12 billion yuan, ROE about 11.62%, gross margin about 13.32%, net margin about 3.79%. 2026Q1 debt-to-assets about 47.80%.
financials_and_earnings.earnings_trend: 2025 growth was stable; 2026Q1 revenue grew about 6.14% and attributable net profit grew about 13.05%. This is resilient but not high-beta growth.
financials_and_earnings.earnings_expectation: No sell-side consensus forecast was used.

risks: Macro consumption and manufacturing demand weakness.
Express and logistics price competition compressing margins.
International business exposed to trade, FX, geopolitical and energy-price risks.
Asset-heavy logistics network, debt and lease liabilities.
Low valuation may reflect limited growth elasticity.

decision_log_entry: 2026-06-02 个股研究：002352.SZ 顺丰控股；仓位角色为观察股/稳健核心候选，操作评级Watch，个股分数60，评级C；当前仓位2.01%仅作为组合模块输入，不记录持仓金额、成本金额、盈亏金额或股数；关键依据为商业逻辑清晰、2025和2026Q1业绩保持正增长、现金流较强、估值处于2024年以来低分位，但物流未进入当前主线登记册，股价低于20/60/120/240日均线，近20日资金净流出且显著弱于沪深300；本档案不生成买卖建议或调仓动作。
